title: Motorola Just Made the Neo HUGE… So Why Pay More? 😬
description:
Motorola's "small" Neo just got huge — 7,000 mAh and a 6.8-inch screen. But there's a catch. 😬

The Motorola Edge 70 Neo launched in India on 24 Nov 2026: 6.8-inch 144Hz AMOLED with 5,200 nits peak brightness, a 7,000 mAh battery (typical), 45W charging (Motorola says 50% in 27 minutes), Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 8 GB + 128 GB, a 50 MP OIS main camera, IP64 and 5 years of security updates. Motorola claims up to 53 hours of battery life. The old Edge 60 Neo had a 6.36-inch screen.

The catch: even with launch offers it's ₹34,999 — while Motorola's own Edge 70 Fusion starts at ₹30,999 with the same 7,000 mAh, a newer Snapdragon 7s Gen 4, 68W charging and an ultrawide camera. First sale: 1 Dec 2026, 12 PM on Flipkart and motorola.in.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 51/100 → WRECK. Want the big battery? The Edge 70 Fusion is the better pick.
